{{Quote|Khobisho the Hutt's servants are near. They are Nikto whose clan has served the Hutts for twelve generations, bred for battle. They are also known to keep formidable pets. Stay cautious.|Lord [[Cytharat]] advises an Imperial operative|<ref name="Mesa" />}}
A '''clan''' of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] was in servitude to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] for twelve generations by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts']] [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Members of the clan who served as [[Khobisho]] the Hutt's bodyguards were known to keep formidable pets, including [[exoboar]] attack hounds. Under Kobisho, Niktos also worked alongside [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] who wielded [[Electroblade training sword/Legends|electroblades]].<ref name="Mesa" />

When Kobisho gathered with fellow Cartel members [[Prodoranya]] and [[Manju (Hutt)|Manju]] at [[Solida Hesk's resort]] on [[Makeb]], Kobisho's Nikto and Rodian forces acted as the resort's security alongside [[Solida Hesk]]'s [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Prodoranya's enforcers and [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-enhanced]] [[Kintan strider/Legends|kintans]], as well as Manju's elite slavers.<ref name="Mesa" />
